chunk_findings.detail: `_rounds` selects a single review gate as the gate “the rounds count over”, but the sample values count every RAN review verdict for the item across all gates in `review`. Given `PR.REVIEW_GATES` containing `rubber_duck` and `critic`, and a completed item with one passed `rubber_duck` verdict and two passed `critic` verdicts, `counts` makes `gate == "critic"`, while `values` for that item is `3`. The resulting `rounds` table therefore claims to count over `critic` but contains total review rounds over all review gates, overestimating the selected gate’s rounds whenever multiple review gates have verdicts.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/services/eta/data.py:_rounds

chunk_findings.detail: When there are no RAN review verdicts at all, `_rounds` still returns one zero sample per completed item instead of an empty sample list. Given one completed span and `facts.outcomes` empty, `counts` is empty, `gate` becomes `DEFAULT_REVIEW_GATE`, and `values` is `[0]`; `build` then creates `rounds.samples=[0.0]`, and with `min_samples=1` `apply_min_samples` reports `p50_s=0` and leaves `insufficient` empty. This contradicts the stated convention that “with no review verdicts at all ... the samples are empty” and turns “no review-round data” into a fabricated zero-round measurement.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/services/eta/data.py:_rounds

chunk_findings.detail: The `lease.waiting` event is added with `log.add("lease.waiting", "W", "w1", T0, at=T0 - 600, ...)`, while every other event in this file passes the event timestamp as the fourth positional argument. Under the fixture’s `Log.add(event, item, actor, at, **data)` convention, this supplies `at` both positionally and as a keyword, so the test raises `TypeError: got multiple values for argument 'at'` before `ED.build` is reached. Even if the fixture accepts `at` as event data, the event’s own timestamp remains `T0`, so a wait-to-claim fold that uses the event timestamp would produce `0`, not the asserted `600`.
chunk_findings.title: tests/test_eta_data.py:test_lease_wait_is_first_wait_signal_to_first_claim
